This Privacy Policy was last modified on July 24, 2017.

Protecting the confidentiality of your information is very important to Mohawk Global Logistics Corp. (“Mohawk”). This privacy policy discloses the privacy practices for [www.mohawkglobal.com](http://www.mohawkglobal.com/) . This privacy policy applies solely to information collected by this Website. This Privacy Policy is incorporated into and is part of the terms of use of the Website (“Terms of Use”). By accessing and using the Website, or any part thereof, you agree that you have read and understand this Privacy Policy, and that in exchange for access to the System, you accept and consent to the privacy practices (and any uses and disclosures of information about you) that are described in this Privacy Policy.
## **INFORMATION COLLECTION AND USE**

We are the sole owners of the information collected on this Site. We only have access to/collect information that you voluntarily give us via email or other direct contact from you. We will not sell or rent this information to anyone.

We will use your information to respond to you, regarding the reason you contacted us. We will not share your information with any third party outside of our organization, other than as necessary to fulfill your request, e.g. to ship an order.
Unless you ask us not to, we may contact you via email in the future to tell you about specials, new products or services, or changes to this privacy policy.
You may opt out of any future contacts from us at any time. You can do the following at any time by contacting us via the email address or phone number given on our Website:
* See what data we have about you, if any.
* Change/correct any data we have about you.
* Have us delete any data we have about you.
* Express any concern you have about our use of your data.
## **INFORMATION SECURITY**

We take precautions to protect your information. When you submit sensitive information via the Website, your information is protected both online and offline. Wherever we collect sensitive information we take steps to protect it. Only employees who need the information to perform a specific job (for example, billing or customer service) are granted access to personally identifiable information. The computers/servers in which we store personally identifiable information are kept in a secure environment.

5. [Umbra Streamlines Customs Entry with Mohawk Global’s Innovative Software Program](https://mohawkglobal.com/case-studies/umbra-streamlines-customs-entry-with-mohawk-globals-innovative-software-program/)
### Overview

Umbra, is a home accessories design and manufacturing company. The company sells more than 2,000 home products through over 25,000 retailers in 120 countries and utilizes Mohawk Global’s Customs Brokerage services.
### Challenge

Failing to report the correct statistical data to U.S. Customs could result in a Census warning and delay entry summary processing. Therefore, it was crucial for Umbra to calculate the correct statistical reporting quantity for the tariff number, on a per line basis. Specific information, such as weight of each piece per part number or SKU, is required on any Customs entry. Umbra was spending excessive time providing weights for each commercial invoice line, where kilos were needed.
### Solution

Mohawk Global offered Umbra its IT capabilities, using an inhouse software program. This allowed them to send Mohawk Global information with weights per part number or SKU. The correct information was then automatically loaded into their parts database with the respective part number or SKU.

**JOB TITLE:** Marketing Operations Specialist
**FLSA CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt
**DEPARTMENT:** Marketing
**REPORTS TO:** SVP of Marketing or Director of Growth
**REVISION DATE** : 09/09/2026

**SUMMARY** : As a Marketing Operations Specialist, you will play a crucial role in executing and optimizing the entire marketing tech stack for effective campaign delivery. You will actively engage with tools such as HubSpot, Clay, Qualified.com, and Salesforce to manage campaigns, ensure data integrity, and streamline automation workflows. In this position, you will closely collaborate with the Director of Growth Marketing to guarantee the systems are functioning at their best, monitor campaign performance, and translate real-time buyer insights into actionable tactics. Your contributions will be vital in establishing efficient processes that enhance campaign effectiveness and directly drive pipeline development.
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Under the supervision of marketing leadership, manage the day-to-day marketing tech stack.
* Build and maintain campaign objects in Salesforce/HubSpot, segment lists, and create workflows to support lead nurturing and optimize campaign performance.
* In collaboration with marketing leadership, establish a campaign reporting framework to support initiatives from ideation through to measurement.
* Own project management for the marketing organization, ensuring accuracy of projects, tasks, and timelines in Click U p.
* Build emails, associate with proper campaigns, and maintain an email marketing calendar.
* Establish and maintain marketing reports in Salesforce.
* Set up Salesforce campaigns, associate segmentations, and ensure attribution accuracy.
* Assist in setting up and managing live and recorded webinars via Zoom, including registration tracking, follow-up emails, and post-event analytics.
* Assist the marketing team in properly using the marketing technology platforms.
* Help develop processes and analyses to measure and improve our efficacy and efficiency.
* In collaboration with BDR leadership, optimize Qualified.com, to ensure precise routing, lead capture, and engagement tracking.
* Ensure marketing and sales data is consistently synced across platforms (e.g., HubSpot and Salesforce) to maintain clean, actionable insights
* Support the execution and QA of marketing campaigns
* Assist with documenting marketing processes and playbooks to drive consistency and team enablement
* Collaborate with sales and BDR teams to ensure accurate campaign attribution, lead follow-up, and program feedback
**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
This job has no supervisory responsibilities.
**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Minimum of 2 years of B2B marketing operations, preferably in SaaS.
* Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
* Excellent verbal, virtual, and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence senior-level executives.
* Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce), sales automation tools, and other relevant technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to strategy and business development.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.

Mohawk API enables you to programmatically interact with Mohawk’s data. ### Overview

Umbra, is a home accessories design and manufacturing company. The company sells more than 2,000 home products through over 25,000 retailers in 120 countries and utilizes Mohawk Global’s Customs Brokerage services.
### Challenge

Failing to report the correct statistical data to U.S. Customs could result in a Census warning and delay entry summary processing. Therefore, it was crucial for Umbra to calculate the correct statistical reporting quantity for the tariff number, on a per line basis. Specific information, such as weight of each piece per part number or SKU, is required on any Customs entry. Umbra was spending excessive time providing weights for each commercial invoice line, where kilos were needed.
### Solution

Mohawk Global offered Umbra its IT capabilities, using an inhouse software program. This allowed them to send Mohawk Global information with weights per part number or SKU. The correct information was then automatically loaded into their parts database with the respective part number or SKU.
### Result

excerpts: ## Marketing Operations Specialist
Marketing Clerical
Remote, AZ, US
30+ days ago Requisition ID: 1179
Apply
Salary Range: $65,000.00 To $85,000.00 Annually
**JOB TITLE:** Marketing Operations Specialist
**FLSA CLASSIFICATION:** Exempt
**DEPARTMENT:** Marketing
**REPORTS TO:** SVP of Marketing or Director of Growth
**REVISION DATE** : 09/09/2026

**SUMMARY** : As a Marketing Operations Specialist, you will play a crucial role in executing and optimizing the entire marketing tech stack for effective campaign delivery. You will actively engage with tools such as HubSpot, Clay, Qualified.com, and Salesforce to manage campaigns, ensure data integrity, and streamline automation workflows. In this position, you will closely collaborate with the Director of Growth Marketing to guarantee the systems are functioning at their best, monitor campaign performance, and translate real-time buyer insights into actionable tactics. Your contributions will be vital in establishing efficient processes that enhance campaign effectiveness and directly drive pipeline development.
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
* Under the supervision of marketing leadership, manage the day-to-day marketing tech stack.
* Build and maintain campaign objects in Salesforce/HubSpot, segment lists, and create workflows to support lead nurturing and optimize campaign performance.
* In collaboration with marketing leadership, establish a campaign reporting framework to support initiatives from ideation through to measurement.
* Own project management for the marketing organization, ensuring accuracy of projects, tasks, and timelines in Click U p.
* Build emails, associate with proper campaigns, and maintain an email marketing calendar.
* Establish and maintain marketing reports in Salesforce.
* Set up Salesforce campaigns, associate segmentations, and ensure attribution accuracy.
* Assist in setting up and managing live and recorded webinars via Zoom, including registration tracking, follow-up emails, and post-event analytics.
* Assist the marketing team in properly using the marketing technology platforms.
* Help develop processes and analyses to measure and improve our efficacy and efficiency.
* In collaboration with BDR leadership, optimize Qualified.com, to ensure precise routing, lead capture, and engagement tracking.
* Ensure marketing and sales data is consistently synced across platforms (e.g., HubSpot and Salesforce) to maintain clean, actionable insights
* Support the execution and QA of marketing campaigns
* Assist with documenting marketing processes and playbooks to drive consistency and team enablement
* Collaborate with sales and BDR teams to ensure accurate campaign attribution, lead follow-up, and program feedback
**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**
This job has no supervisory responsibilities.
**QUALIFICATIONS:**
* Minimum of 2 years of B2B marketing operations, preferably in SaaS.
* Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Supply Chain Management, or related field.
* Excellent verbal, virtual, and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and influence senior-level executives.
* Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce), sales automation tools, and other relevant technologies.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a data-driven approach to strategy and business development.
* Highly motivated, goal-oriented, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.

You will actively engage with tools such as HubSpot, Clay, Qualified.com, and Salesforce to manage campaigns, ensure data integrity, and streamline automation workflows. In this position, you will closely collaborate with the Director of Growth Marketing to guarantee the systems are functioning at their best, monitor campaign performance, and translate real-time buyer insights into actionable tactics. Your contributions will be vital in establishing efficient processes that enhance campaign effectiveness and directly drive pipeline development.
**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Own project management for the marketing organization, ensuring accuracy of projects, tasks, and timelines in Click U p.
* Build emails, associate with proper campaigns, and maintain an email marketing calendar.
* Establish and maintain marketing reports in Salesforce.
